name: Luminous Ooze AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

generalAbilities.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
generalAbilities.description: A Luminous Ooze can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

defensiveAbilities.name: Bedazzling
defensiveAbilities.description: 5 feet. A luminous ooze constantly sheds distracting multicolored light. A creature that ends its turn within the aura must attempt a DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Dazzled until the end of its next turn. On a critical failure, it instead becomes Blinded until the end of its next turn.

defensiveAbilities.name: Lightning Catcher
defensiveAbilities.description: Whenever the luminous ooze's electricity immunity prevents it from taking damage, it gains 8 temporary HP. Until the end of its next turn, the luminous ooze's pseudopod Strike deals an additional 1d6 Electricity Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Light Up
offensiveAbilities.description:
The ooze glows with blinding brightness. All creatures within a 30ft Emanation must attempt a DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected

Success The creature is Dazzled until the end of its next turn.

Failure The creature is Blinded until the end of its next turn.
